zero_attribution_rule: Never add or leave co-author, AI, or tool attribution in any output.
verification: Independent local instruction simulations; no live workflow execution, GitHub writes, remote hosts, deployment, browser assertions, or container actions.

repair_checks.X1: Factory authorized local-base merge and handover boundary
repair_checks.X3: Deployment-job success permits explicit-issue manual assignment without live smoke proof
repair_checks.X4: Manual handoff distinguishes job proof from missing live identity/smoke

preserved_history: Initial reports retain the pre-correction ambiguity findings; recheck-results.json records decisions against corrected instructions. These outputs are raw traces rather than executable integration tests.
